sources.title: HKSAR Immigration Department: application for HKSAR passport
sources.publisher: Immigration Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: Hong Kong Immigration Department's current passport service defines HKSAR-passport eligibility as Chinese citizenship, HKSAR permanent residence and a valid permanent identity card, separately from Documents of Identity for Visa Purposes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A person is eligible to apply for a HKSAR Passport if he/she is: a Chinese citizen; a permanent resident of the HKSAR.

sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: eligibility and electronic delivery
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity and online-visa purpose are anchored by the current Government Information and Press Office announcement that directs visitors to this exact domain. Its FAQ supplies the all-nationality scope and emailed/PDF issuance mechanics.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E-Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: regular-passport application process
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity is anchored by the live Government announcement linking to this exact service. Its current process requires the travel passport to match the application and excludes non-regular travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: HKSAR passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 F5A service makes an online tourism eVisa available to citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email; an HKSAR passport holder is expressly a Chinese citizen.
conditions: Use a valid HKSAR passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket, hotel or host evidence and sufficient funds. F5A is tourism only, single-entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. The visa certificate is emailed, so this is electronic issuance rather than online preapproval followed by border issuance.
This is HKSAR-passport scope only; it does not classify PRC, Macao, BN(O), Documents of Identity, diplomatic, official, service or special documents.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Apply online using the HKSAR passport and upload the tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: HKSAR passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's institutional Government page authenticates its online visa service; the service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email.
conditions: Apply using the HKSAR passport that will be used for travel; the official portal excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload the required visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
This is HKSAR-passport scope only; it does not classify PRC, Macao, BN(O), Documents of Identity, diplomatic, official, service or special documents.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application with the HKSAR passport to be used for travel.
Pay online and receive the issued eVisa by email before travel.
Carry the issued record and meet entry-point and final-admission conditions.
